title: Restriction to a localized site is exact
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a Grothendieck site [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology] and let $W$ be an object. Give $\mathcal C/W$ the localized topology, with coverings whose underlying families cover in $\mathcal C$. For the abelian sheaf categories [def-sp-abelian], the restriction functor $j_W^*:\operatorname{Ab}(\mathcal C)\to\operatorname{Ab}(\mathcal C/W)$ is exact: for every short exact sequence $0\to G_1\to G_2\to G_3\to0$ on $\mathcal C$, the sequence $0\to j_W^*G_1\to j_W^*G_2\to j_W^*G_3\to0$ is exact on $\mathcal C/W$.
